fields.label: Additional robots.txt directives
fields.name: robots_txt_directives
fields.instructions: Only add rules that differ from the standard WordPress robots.txt output. Enter one directive per line, for example "Disallow: /internal/".

fields.label: Security contact email
fields.name: security_txt_contact_email
fields.instructions: Email address for reports of security vulnerabilities. Leave empty to use the WordPress administration email address.

fields.label: Security policy URL
fields.name: security_txt_policy
fields.instructions: Optional HTTPS URL that explains how security vulnerabilities should be reported.
